title: Source-alignment follow-up — targeted Persian revisions
description: A focused source-aligned follow-up to Increment 53. The remaining historical alignment cases and the 63 Chapter 9 say-events not covered by Increments 38, 52, or 53 were checked against the gp32 English event text and the active Persian source. Twenty-three targeted revisions are proposed in total; ambiguous event-boundary cases are retained without speculative rewriting. Independent native-Persian sign-off remains pending.
style_guide: Narration uses contemporary literary-conversational Persian: intimate, restrained, natural, and never uniformly formal or slang-heavy.
Dialogue remains spoken and character-specific; preserve hesitation, pauses, and unfinished phrases.
Preserve source meaning and emotional understatement; do not add explanations or actions not present in the English.
Correct translationese, semantic drift, awkward collocations, and lost nuances without over-editing faithful existing Persian.

review_scope.method: The 48 remaining historical alignment entries were re-examined against the English gp32 source and active Persian recovery text; eight clear revisions were proposed. In addition, all 63 Chapter 9 say-events not present in Increments 38, 52, or 53 were checked against the English source; 15 further targeted revisions were proposed, while faithful lines and ambiguous event boundaries were retained. Together with the earlier proofread coverage, this completes the first source-aligned assistant review of all 117 Chapter 9 say-events. This is not a complete line-by-line review of the full 2,228 voiced say-events.
review_scope.source: gp32 / Insani 2005 English localization, represented by the repository's story-gp32.json events
